_about: Benzene (1) + n-Nonane (2): isobaric T-x-y at 101.3 kPa. Rows: liquid mole fraction of benzene, boiling temperature in K, vapour mole fraction of benzene, as stored in the ThermoML Archive record (mole fractions of the other component converted with x_1 = 1 - x_2).

source.citation: Gupta, B. S.[Bhupender S.], Lee, M.-J.[Ming-Jer], Isobaric vapor-liquid equilibrium for binary systemsof toluene + o-xylene, benzene + o-xylene, nonane + benzene and nonane + heptane at 101.3 kPa, Fluid Phase Equilib. 352 (2013) 86-92
source.access: The journal article may be subscription-only; the same data is public in the NIST TRC ThermoML Archive (NIST open license).
source.tables: ThermoML record, PureOrMixtureData 20, 21. The table number in the article was not checked.

notes: Read with validation/python/vle_batch.py. Consistency point test (Redlich-Kister fit to T-x): mean |dy| 0.0050. Pure-component boiling points of the set within 0.09 K of the vapour-pressure records. To be checked by a person against the record (AGENTS.md rule 4).
